- 7.49 ppm (dddd, J = 8.0, 7.3, 1.9, 0.5 Hz, 1H) - aromatic proton

- Multiple signals in the aromatic region (125-142 ppm and 166 ppm for carbonyl)

The 13C NMR shows only one signal in the aliphatic region (52.24 ppm), which confirms there is only 1 CH3 group in this compound.

1. 1H NMR shows one singlet at 3.83 ppm integrating for 3H
2. 13C NMR shows only one aliphatic carbon at 52.24 ppm
3. HSQC confirms the correlation between these two signals for a CH3 group
